# kan-section-heading



<!-- Auto Generated Below -->


## Overview

A section heading in the terminal style, like "── projects ──" (KIT-006). It's a real heading,
so it's in the page outline; the rule characters are hidden from screen readers.

## Properties

| Property | Attribute | Description                                                  | Type                    | Default |
| -------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------- | ------- |
| `level`  | `level`   | The heading level, from 2 to 6. Anything else renders an h2. | `2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6` | `2`     |


## Slots

| Slot | Description          |
| ---- | -------------------- |
|      | The heading's label. |


## Shadow Parts

| Part        | Description                           |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `"heading"` | The heading element.                  |
| `"label"`   | The label.                            |
| `"rule"`    | The rules before and after the label. |
